result.summary: This PR extracts local-network-address management (mapLocalHost, AddLocal/RemoveLocal/SeenLocal/IsLocal/GetLocalAddress and GetReachabilityFrom) out of net.cpp and CNode into a new LocalAddressManager class, with a global instance (g_localaddressman) used everywhere the old free functions were. It also introduces a netglobals.h/.cpp file to hold fDiscover/fListen/strSubVersion and break a circular dependency. The author states explicitly there is no behavioral change; this is groundwork for the larger net/net_processing split project (#33958).
result.problem: Local address logic was tightly coupled to CNode and net.cpp globals, making it hard to test in isolation and blocking the broader effort to separate net from net_processing. Maintainers working on that split project feel this coupling as a persistent obstacle to incremental, reviewable refactors.

result.card: This PR extracts local-network-address bookkeeping (mapLocalHost, AddLocal/RemoveLocal/GetLocalAddress, GetReachabilityFrom) out of net.cpp and CNode into a new LocalAddressManager class, as groundwork for the larger net/net_processing split project (issue #33958). The author states explicitly there is no behavioral change, and review discussion so far is limited to file naming and placement (maflcko, fjahr), with no substantive objection. The PR is draft, CI is failing, needs rebase, and the author went silent after saying a circular-dependency problem in the extraction was 'non-trivial' and required investigation, so review right now risks being invalidated by a pending rework. It conflicts with several other open PRs touching net.cpp/net.h. Priority in p2p is moderate: it is useful preparatory refactoring but carries no direct correctness, security, or user-facing benefit on its own.
